title: Has anyone managed to successfully progress in creating games using only basic subscriptions like the Plus subscription?
author: R_dva
selftext: while developing and game become more complex, any action start eat a lot "usage" "limits". its mean there no other way besides increasing the subscription level?

comments.author: TheReservedList
comments.body: Yes. In fact, I've done so with no subscription at all.

replies.author: xendelaar
replies.body: How did you manage that?  Just stopping after the limit is reached? Or switching between other llms?

comments.author: kokutouchichi
comments.body: Absolutely.  If you're using it like a tool surgically fixing this ans that while building your game it's easy. I have codex and Claude and on the 20 dollar sub for both. Ive been able to knock out projects and games left and right bouncing between the two and doing modeling on the downtime while those are running. Non stop game studio!

comments.author: Ohgood9002
comments.body:
Ask your AI why its running through usage so fast. It could be running a suite of tests after every little thing which grows and grows and grows.

Have you established a plan? Even just saying "hey lets break this plan up into gates" goes a long way

comments.author: Economy_Bedroom3902
comments.body:
I'm using a plus subscription.  But all my work has just been underlying tech work so far.

I'm also not asking it for a fully featured/running game over a weekend, because I don't want to burn millions of credits and weeks of effort undoing stuff done the wrong way up front.

comments.author: goblingamescompany
comments.body:
Yeah, used Claude pro for a year up until my demo was released (full game was fine too).

I recently only upgraded to Max because I wanted to do more and I saw the value.

Here's my game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5376910/The_Last_God/?beta=0

replies.author: Frosty-Breath-81
replies.body: that trailer music is absolute ear rape. there's lots of great cc0 or copyright free music that would plug right in to your game.

replies.author: goblingamescompany
replies.body: Lmfao on the radical candor 🤣 I appreciate it. I'm currently working through redoing the music at the moment, definitely placeholder 😅

replies.author: Frosty-Breath-81
replies.body: I dunno if you want any other feedback, but I think there's a lot of changes you need to make, simply based on the trailer and screenshots

replies.author: goblingamescompany
replies.body: Please send them my way! I have 2 testers so far and the gameplay loop is positive but happy to take anything!!

replies.author: Frosty-Breath-81
replies.body: maybe you're already aware, but the art is all sorts of fucked up. completely different styles, some pixel art some not, background not properly removed from lots of objects, lots of obvious ugly gpt-image art, UI issues/art direction. honestly it would probably look better as a demo with just basic shapes instead of what's there now.

comments.author: thvaz
comments.body: Yes, it is what I'm doing now. When my limit is over, there a lot of things I can do by myself.

comments.author: PettyPotatoJuror
comments.body: I think of Plus as the touch grass subscription. It limits the number of continuous hours you work with it.  Assuming you have a job, friends, family, 5 hours is a reasonable limit (for mental health if nothing else). But it will take you longer to reach your finished product.

comments.author: couldgiveaflyingfck
comments.body: I had the $99 plan for about 5 days and, It was clear I needed the $199 plan. Now that I've had the $199 plan, I've been extremely efficient with my usage and could maybe make the $99 plan work but I would have to take 2 days off of work which I am not ready to do.

comments.author: Any-Blacksmith-2054
comments.body: I created all of them in 1.5 weeks on $20 Claude https://maxims.top/

comments.author: Blake9712
comments.body: I mean, I’m happy with my progress using Claude pro over the past about 8 months but I’m not at the demo stage yet (I’m close to a 200 item 2 floor demo) and plus the first 3 months for me where spent making an asset builder so I can make the assets myself since I didn’t have the usage or like Claude’s attempts at making assets back then.

comments.author: hblok
comments.body:
I'm doing a medium sized game on $20 Pro Claude plus a tiny bit of GPT image generation.

Progress could maybe be faster. However, it's just an after-work hobby, so I'm having problems spending all the weekly tokens.

I'd say I'm somewhere around 70% done after a month.

comments.author: ArmandoGalvez
comments.body: While I know one shots and Claude are insanely fast at doing stuff, I'm relying purely on gemini 5 USD Suscriotion Code aissistance for my music game https://youtu.be/LW3-Bd5fpLs, I reidinr have much money to spend on Claude higher stuff, and I am not using any 3D ai either, Im doing those by hand, mostly because I enjoy this part of game development

comments.author: Brettinabox
comments.body: Yup, im like halfway done with my SHMUP rougelike

comments.author: sircontagious
comments.body: I have a hard time reaching my plus weekly limit, but i often reach my 5 hour. I also handmake basically all of my assets and I dictate all of the system design. From watching some fellow devs spamming claude I think a lot of tokens get burned on thinking for system and architecture, and then also for asset integration loops. Personally i think experience and having a personal quality bar above what claude can do for art and sound will make it hard to use more than Plus affords.

replies.author: Ok-Philosopher333
replies.body: This is what I’m running into. Specifically for enemy AI, ideally once the systems are finalized the overhead should be greatly reduced for working on much smaller modular pieces but for now it’s painful lol

comments.author: RepulsiveRaisin7
comments.body:
You get far with cheap models on Opencode Go, Command Code GOAT, Mistral etc. GPT Plus was solid in the past, not sure about now though. And Opencode now gives you $500 of GLM even.

When you need more usage, combine multiple plans with litellm. It can be a pain to set up tho, a number of providers have bugs
